sourcesContent:
app TypedExactNumbers
Given
 ## Constructor defaults retain canonical minor units, including half-even rounding.
 Ledger { amount:decimal=1.50, cash:money=money(2.505,"EUR"), amounts:decimal[], coins:money[], seedAmounts:decimal[]=[0.10,0.20], seedCoins:money[]=[money(0.10,"EUR"),money(0.20,"EUR")], maybeAmount:decimal?, maybeCash:money?, maybeAmounts:decimal[]?, maybeCoins:money[]? }
 policy Ledger read=public
When
 crud Ledger by=members fields=amount,cash,amounts,coins,seedAmounts,seedCoins,maybeAmount,maybeCash,maybeAmounts,maybeCoins
 ## Decimal sums are exact; money uses matching currencies and an explicit empty-sum currency.
 scenario add(ledger:Ledger,delta:decimal,cash:money,amounts:decimal[],coins:money[],accept:bool) -> decimal by=members
  do
   set ledger {amount=ledger.amount+delta+sum(amounts)+sum(ledger.seedAmounts),cash=ledger.cash+cash+sum(coins,"EUR")+sum(ledger.seedCoins,"EUR"),amounts=amounts,coins=coins}
   require accept
   return ledger.amount
 scenario cash(ledger:Ledger) -> money by=members
  do return ledger.cash
 scenario amounts(ledger:Ledger) -> decimal[] by=members
  do return [sum(ledger.amounts),ledger.amount]
 scenario coins(ledger:Ledger) -> money[] by=members
  do
   require sum(ledger.coins,"EUR")<ledger.cash
   return ledger.coins
 scenario maybeAmount(ledger:Ledger) -> decimal? by=members
  do return ledger.maybeAmount
 scenario maybeCash(ledger:Ledger) -> money? by=members
  do return ledger.maybeCash
 scenario maybeAmounts(ledger:Ledger) -> decimal[]? by=members
  do return ledger.maybeAmounts
 scenario maybeCoins(ledger:Ledger) -> money[]? by=members
  do return ledger.maybeCoins
 ## Nullable inputs accept values or omission; omission clears the corresponding nullable field.
 scenario optional(ledger:Ledger,amount:decimal?,cash:money?,amounts:decimal[]?,coins:money[]?) -> decimal? by=members
  do
   set ledger {maybeAmount=amount,maybeCash=cash,maybeAmounts=amounts,maybeCoins=coins}
   return ledger.maybeAmount
 ## Original parameter literals retain their wire values in replay receipts.
 scenario defaults(delta:decimal=0.10,cash:money=money(0.20,"EUR"),amounts:decimal[]=[0.10,0.20],coins:money[]=[money(0.10,"EUR")]) -> money by=members
  do
   require delta+sum(amounts)==0.40
   return cash+sum(coins,"EUR")
 ## Omitted nullable parameters use constructors; explicit null bypasses those defaults.
 scenario nullableDefaults(value:money?=money(2.505,"EUR"),values:money[]?=[money(0.10,"EUR"),money(0.20,"EUR")]) -> money? by=members
  do return value
 ## Checked construction converts major units and rounds ties to the even minor unit.
 scenario construct(value:decimal) -> money by=members
  do return money(value,"EUR")
 scenario empty(values:money[]) -> money by=members
  do return sum(values,"EUR")
Then
